text:
maria.design: quick check — new timeflow sampler PR landed. focus ring + copy updates in the preview build. would love a quick :eyes: before we merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1145

ben.prod: skimmed it — nice. one question: the p95 tooltip copy feels a bit jargon-y. current: `p95 latency (ms) across requests sampled`

maria.design: thanks. alternatives I was playing with:
- 'P95 latency — value exceeded by 5% of requests'
- 'P95 latency (ms): 95% of requests complete within this time'
Which reads better?

carla.eng: prefer the second one (clearer for non-ML folks). also technical note: the sampler handle hit-target is too small on mobile — currently 24px. propose 36px and larger touch padding.

carla.eng: quick CSS snippet for the handle sizing if helpful:
```css
.sampler-handle { width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; }
```

dmitri.ml: FYI increasing handle size changes heatmap snap behaviour slightly (touch jitter). tests show increasing the sampler debounce from 50ms -> 80ms smooths throughput calc and avoids false spikes.

emma.a11y: a11y nits: focus ring color fails AA in dark mode. numbers: focus #005fcc on bg #0b1220 -> contrast ~3.8:1 which is below 4.5:1. options: use #003a8c or a 3px double outline to improve contrast. also add aria-label for the handle.

maria.design: good catch @emma.a11y — I'll move to a 3px double outline and add aria-label 'Adjust time range sampler'.

ben.prod: :thumbsup: can we add tiny microcopy under the timepicker: 'Sampled view — may omit rare spikes' — helps set expectation for customers.

carla.eng: deploy-bot: staging build 1145 is green. logs: `sampler-size=36 debounce=80`

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/preview/1145 :rocket:

emma.a11y: quick keyboard test: tab lands on the handle but screenreader says "button" only. recommend role="slider" + aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow to communicate range.

maria.design: noted — I'll add role="slider" and aria attributes plus the updated focus CSS. planning to update PR after e2e and a11y tests.

ben.prod: let's ship once regression tests are clean. please add a short changelog note for the release: 'Sampler: improved accessibility, larger touch target, and clarified P95 tooltip copy'.

carla.eng: running e2e now, will ping here when green.

maria.design: thanks all — appreciate the quick reviews.
